limits: Synthetic records only: no real provider's terms were reviewed (OD-1 deferred) and nothing here says any provider permits training; host-run units come from synthetic fixtures. Coverage is by exact model id from the attempt_start event; units without one cannot be covered. The record's provider name is informational, not checked against the host; binding is by host plus exact model id. Host and model come from the ingested trace data (rollout record, attempt_start event) and are not independently attested. One record covers one host per export. Privacy is checked for the owner's uid and mode bits only (no ACLs). Expiry is the owner's validUntil date compared with the export's UTC day; no review period is set by Agent Braid.
outcome: passed: T008: load_terms_decision reads terms/<name>.json under the plugin home's lightning directory and the export refuses every non-fixture unit not covered by it with terms-gate-missing before writing anything, with a text naming no path or field value and no chained cause. All records are SYNTHETIC, written to temporary homes, naming a fictional provider and model; none is committed, and a repository scan finds no file with the record schema. Without a record (or naming a missing file) a fixture plus host-run export refuses, while a fixture-only export succeeds and cites no record. With a permitting synthetic record covering the host and model, the host units export and the manifest cites the record's relative path and SHA-256 and validates against the schema; a fixture-only export with the same record cites none. Per-unit binding: a record for another host or another model, a unit outside the record next to covered ones, a unit with no attempt_start model, and a unit of another host with the same model id all refuse. Outcomes forbids-training, undecided and unknown values refuse, through the export and through the loader alone. Dates: a review after the export day, a validUntil before it, inverted dates, an impossible date, a timestamp and a missing review date refuse; both bounds are inclusive. Malformed records refuse: missing, empty or doubled terms, an http URL, no or control-character provider, empty, non-list or duplicate models, an unknown host, an unknown key, another schema, a non-object, invalid JSON, a full valid record with one key duplicated and a valid record padded to one byte over 16 KiB; an https URL record is accepted. Unsafe paths refuse: absolute, dotted, other directories, subdirectories, other extensions or names with spaces (also when such files exist), a record readable by others, a symlinked record, a symlink swapped in after the path checks (the open does not follow it), and a lightning/ or terms/ directory with group or other bits (0777, 0750, 0705). The record is read once, bounded to 16 KiB plus one byte. Refusals carry no chained cause and no context. The supervised and rollout writers apply the same gate. check_manifest refuses host-model records without termsDecision and a cited path or SHA-256 that is not the verified record's, also through export_dataset (nothing written). Negative controls (mutants, each fails a test): the gate skipped, the per-unit check ignoring the outcome, the loader accepting any outcome, any host, any model, the review date ignored, validUntil ignored, the terms version or URL ignored, http URLs accepted, any path accepted, the privacy check removed, the export clock ignored, a record cited for a fixture-only export, the cited hash unchecked, the directory privacy check removed, symlinks followed, an unbounded read, the size check removed, duplicate keys allowed, refusal context carried and the descriptor check removed.
